adopted: reproduce bugs with fixtures before fixes
build, types, lint, tests, browser and diff verification

analysis.engine: Stockfish.js 19.0.1 Lite single-thread; optional full engine only in position explorer

openingSource.normalization: Piece placement, side to move, castling rights, legal en-passant square; clocks excluded. Documented outgoing position edges recognize transpositions.

supplement.scope: Four explicitly published London mainline/setup sequences. Only factual move sequences are retained with attribution; article prose is not reproduced. Named ECO identities continue to come from the CC0 reference.

analysis.classification: Book is source provenance, independent of engine completion. Documented moves may still create review issues from outcome loss. Other ratings require legal position-matched evidence and depth >=12, with exact terminal exceptions. Brilliant requires confirmed root/second-choice separation and a sustained material sacrifice at depths >=20 and >=22. No proprietary platform parity claimed.
analysis.accuracy: Expected-outcome loss uses White-normalized WDL when both evaluations provide it, otherwise logistic centipawn estimates. Engine first-choice moves have zero attributed loss to avoid capped child-search horizon penalties. Per-move score = clamp(103.1668 * exp(-0.04354 * lossPercentagePoints) - 3.1669, 0, 100). Game score is the arithmetic mean of supported mover samples. Unsupported moves are excluded; sample counts are exposed. This is an AXIS heuristic, not the Lichess game aggregator or a calibrated measure of human skill.

imports.architecture: Monthly Chess.com pages and bounded 100-game Lichess pages. Page checkpoints, game records, analyses and metadata commit atomically in IndexedDB v2. Incremental sync is independent of analysis. Changed records are persisted individually.
imports.accountSwitch: After a valid page is fetched, replace the selected platform’s prior player games and linked evidence; preserve manually imported PGNs and the other platform. Failed account lookup preserves the old library. Old platform checkpoints are removed. AI review notes lack provenance and are cleared when an account is replaced.
imports.durability: Await each page before fetching the next; use strict transaction durability; retain legacy data during migration. If storage cannot be read, block writes for that session to avoid overwriting an unreadable library. Surface quota/persistence failures and restore the prior in-memory page.
imports.retries: At most two bounded retries for 429/502/503/504, honoring Retry-After. Long delays stop with a resumable error. Cancellation uses AbortController.
limits: Browser storage and memory remain finite; this release validates a 10000-record storage fixture and a 502-game browser import, not unlimited physical capacity.
Lichess incremental sync is by game creation time. Recheck full history discovers older correspondence games that completed later.
A non-advancing timestamp page stops explicitly with its checkpoint preserved; no ambiguous boundary is silently skipped.
imports.pgnCompletion: PGN import remains busy and keeps its draft until IndexedDB acknowledges the write. Only then does it report success and close. Storage failure removes only newly added PGN rows. Browser regression holds transaction acknowledgment, checks busy feedback, then releases and immediately reloads to verify persistence.

learning.verification: Source game replay, source theme tag, legal published solution through actual checkmate, explicit terminal motif geometry and unique normalized puzzle positions. Ambiguous epaulette tags were rejected. Difficulty progression uses line length followed by source rating.
learning.corridor: Taught as another name for back-rank mate; no duplicate path or inflated exercise count.
learning.explanations: Final king square, checker, blocked and unavailable flights are derived from the board. Verifiable one-move checking alternatives include a legal refutation where available. No claim that every move outside the source line loses.

academy.examples: Guided examples explicitly name the move being demonstrated and do not claim unique best play. Includes intermediate minor-piece exchanges, Carlsbad plans, a multi-move Arabian mating line, reserve tempi and sixth-rank rook defense.
academy.language: New prose is English and labeled accordingly in the French interface. Full French lesson translation is deferred.
academy.progress: Study completion persists; reading does not establish mastery.

learning.personalization: Recommendations use verified completed game-review observations, show the source decisions, and link to existing Academy lessons. Personal engine lines no longer enter the default structured puzzle queue. Historical personal attempts and explicit game-review drills are retained.
limits: Legal and geometric validation does not prove unique best play or all defensive branches.
No controlled learning-outcome evaluation or independent chess-educator review has been completed.

browserCoverage: Both themes, English/French landing, 1280x720 through 1920x1080 desktop, mobile/zoom-equivalent layouts, 502-game imports, account replacement/failure/reload, 20-row lists, real engine reviews, recovery, full-engine isolation, fullscreen/fallback controls, Academy interaction/quiz/progress, curated sessions, recommendations, and a 1000-game rendered fixture.
releaseGate: Merge only after these checks pass on the PR. Verify the deployed commit metadata and smoke-test the production URL. Do not describe unvalidated capacity or pedagogical effectiveness as production-ready.
